Sandbox_KeypadLock_AllowRemove_tooltip: If enabled, players can remove keypads from doors. If disabled, only admins can remove keypads.
Sandbox_KeypadLock_PicklockCompatGuard_t: If enabled, server enforces keypad lock state and prevents external picklock mods from bypassing keypad-protected doors.
Sandbox_KeypadLock_SpawnInWorld_tooltip: If enabled, you can find the Keypad Device as loot in the world (e.g. electronics stores). Otherwise, it will only be obtainable via admin or crafting.
